stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Computer Use on Mac, Letting AI Click and Navigate Your Desktop

key_facts.fact: Claude can now click, scroll, and navigate web pages and applications on Mac to complete tasks like opening files, browsing the web, and running dev tools
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic PBC wants users to give Claude the keys to their computer, announcing new 'computer use' functionality for its artificial intelligence assistant so it can now click, scroll and navigate through web pages and applications to complete tasks on behalf of users.

key_facts.fact: The feature is available as a research preview for Claude Pro and Max subscribers on macOS only
key_facts.excerpt: For the feature to work, you just need to be on a qualifying subscription plan.

key_facts.fact: Claude uses a tiered approach: it first checks for direct integrations (Google Calendar, Slack), then falls back to computer control using the screen if no connector exists
key_facts.excerpt: When Claude is given a task to complete, it will look to see if it has the right integrations to perform it using tools such as Google Calendar and Slack. But if it doesn't have the right connector, it will fall back onto computer use.

key_facts.fact: Pairs with Dispatch, a mobile tool debuted last week that lets users assign tasks to Claude from their phone to be completed on their Mac
key_facts.excerpt: It notably pairs with Dispatch, which is a mobile tool that debuted last week. With Dispatch, users can assign tasks to Claude from their smartphone, and have it complete those assignments using their computer.

key_facts.fact: Safety features include a permission-first approach where Claude requests access before touching new applications, and users can stop Claude at any time
key_facts.excerpt: Claude requests access before touching new applications. Users can stop Claude at any time.

key_facts.fact: The feature competes directly with OpenClaw-like computer use capabilities from Perplexity, Meta's Manus, and others in the growing AI agent space
key_facts.excerpt: In other words, Anthropic itself is doing OpenClaw stuff now. The AI agent movement started on Claude before being bought by OpenAI. Now Perplexity Computer and Meta's Manus are active in the space.

stories.headline: Google Launches Antigravity Coding Agent in AI Studio for Full-Stack App Building from Prompts

key_facts.fact: Google launched a full-stack 'vibe coding' experience in AI Studio powered by a new Antigravity coding agent that translates prompts into production-ready applications
key_facts.excerpt: Start building real apps for the modern web with the Antigravity coding agent along with Firebase backend integrations, now in Google AI Studio.

key_facts.fact: The system automatically integrates Firebase, detecting when apps need databases or authentication and provisioning Cloud Firestore and Firebase Authentication
key_facts.excerpt: Google AI Studio now integrates Firebase directly into the development process. The system detects when applications require a database or user authentication and provisions Cloud Firestore and Firebase Authentication automatically.

key_facts.fact: Supports Next.js alongside React and Angular, with persistent sessions that let users resume work across devices
key_facts.excerpt: The platform now supports Next.js alongside React and Angular, extending its use for modern web applications. Persistent sessions allow users to resume work across devices without losing progress.

key_facts.fact: The Antigravity agent understands entire project structures and chat history, enabling faster iteration and precise multi-step code edits
key_facts.excerpt: Antigravity now deeply understands an entire project structure and chat history. This enables faster iteration and precise multi-step code edits for complex applications.

key_facts.fact: Includes a built-in secrets management system for securely storing API keys and credentials for external service connections
key_facts.excerpt: Developers can connect APIs, payment systems, and Google services, with credentials stored through a built-in secrets management system.

stories.headline: Meta Acqui-Hires Dreamer AI Agent Startup, Adding Ex-Stripe CTO to Superintelligence Labs

key_facts.fact: Meta acqui-hired the co-founders of agentic AI startup Dreamer, including CEO David Singleton (former Stripe CTO and Google Android VP), Hugo Barra (ex-Meta VR head), and CDO Nicholas Jitkoff (Chrome OS designer)
key_facts.excerpt: Dreamer's team, which includes former Meta and Google LLC executive Hugo Barra, will go to work within Meta's Superintelligence Labs group under Chief AI Officer and former Scale AI Inc. founder Alexandr Wang.

key_facts.fact: The team joins Meta's Superintelligence Labs under Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, working on AI agents and associated projects
key_facts.excerpt: They'll be working on AI agents and associated projects, the report said.

key_facts.fact: Dreamer had raised $56 million at a $500 million valuation in November 2024; Wang was an angel investor in that round
key_facts.excerpt: Dreamer raised $56 million at a $500 million valuation in November 2024. Wang was an angel investor in that round.

key_facts.fact: Dreamer remains a standalone legal entity; Meta receives a non-exclusive license to its technology; investors will be paid more than their original investment
key_facts.excerpt: Under the terms of the deal, Dreamer will remain a standalone legal entity. Meta receives a non-exclusive license to the technology. The backers of Dreamer will be paid more than their investment in the startup.

key_facts.fact: CEO Singleton demonstrated the technology to Mark Zuckerberg earlier in 2026 before the deal
key_facts.excerpt: Singleton demonstrated the technology to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg earlier in 2026.

stories.headline: Cisco Launches LLM Security Leaderboard; Anthropic Claims 8 of Top 10 Spots

key_facts.fact: Cisco launched its LLM Security Leaderboard at RSAC 2026, ranking models by resistance to adversarial attacks including single-turn and multi-turn jailbreak attempts
key_facts.excerpt: Today, Cisco launched the LLM Security Leaderboard, a comprehensive resource for evaluating model security risk and susceptibility to adversarial attacks.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic dominated with 8 of the top 10 spots: Claude Opus 4.5 at #1, Sonnet 4.5 at #2, and Haiku 4.5 at #3
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic dominated the leaderboard, holding 8 out of the top 10 spots. 1st place: Claude Opus 4.5, 2nd: Sonnet 4.5, 3rd: Haiku 4.5.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 placed 7th and GPT 5 Nano 9th; Mistral models occupied the bottom positions alongside DeepSeek, Cohere, Qwen, and xAI
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI secured two positions: 7th place GPT-5.2 and 9th place GPT 5 Nano. Mistral occupied the last two positions with Magistral Small 2509 and Ministral 3 14b.

key_facts.fact: The leaderboard evaluates multi-turn conversational attacks that better reflect real-world adversarial behavior where attackers degrade guardrails over longer conversations
key_facts.excerpt: They 'explicitly evaluate multiturn conversational attacks, which better reflect real-world adversarial behavior where attackers attempt to degrade model guardrails over longer conversations.'

key_facts.fact: Cisco's AI Readiness Index found 83% of organizations plan to deploy agentic AI, but only 29% felt ready to do so securely
key_facts.excerpt: Cisco's own AI Readiness Index found 83% of organizations planned to deploy agentic AI, but only 29% felt ready to do so securely.

stories.headline: Google Deploys Gemini Agents to Crawl Dark Web, Processing 10M+ Events Daily at 98% Accuracy

key_facts.fact: Google launched a dark web intelligence service in Google Threat Intelligence using Gemini agents that process 8-10 million dark web events daily in public preview
key_facts.excerpt: Google's Gemini AI agents are crawling the dark web, sifting through upward of 10 million posts a day to find a handful of threats relevant to a particular organization.

key_facts.fact: Internal tests show 98% accuracy in analyzing millions of daily external events, covering initial access broker activity, data leaks, and insider threats
key_facts.excerpt: Google threat hunters told The Register that their internal tests show it can analyze millions of daily external events with 98 percent accuracy.

key_facts.fact: Traditional dark-web monitoring tools use regex-based keyword scraping; the Gemini-powered system uses AI to distill relevant threats from the noise
key_facts.excerpt: For comparison, traditional dark-web monitoring tools mostly scrape for key terms and use regex to match those terms.

key_facts.fact: Announced at RSAC 2026 alongside Google's completed Wiz acquisition integration and broader agentic SOC strategy powered by Gemini models
key_facts.excerpt: Google also repeated today that it has completed its acquisition of Wiz Inc. Google plans to integrate Wiz's technology into its broader platform to create an AI-ready security solution.

key_facts.fact: Part of a broader 'agentic security operations center' strategy introducing adaptive AI agents that can investigate alerts, synthesize data, and respond at machine speed
key_facts.excerpt: Leading the list of announcements is a strategy described as an 'agentic security operations center' powered by its latest Gemini AI models. Google is introducing adaptive AI agents that can investigate alerts.

stories.headline: RSAC 2026: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Cisco Launch AI Agent Security Platforms in Coordinated Push

key_facts.fact: CrowdStrike expanded Falcon to discover shadow AI agents, MCP servers, and LLM runtimes across endpoints, SaaS, and cloud, treating the endpoint as the control plane for AI security
key_facts.excerpt: CrowdStrike announced an expansion of its Falcon cybersecurity platform to secure artificial intelligence systems as enterprises deploy more autonomous AI agents across endpoints, SaaS applications and cloud environments.

key_facts.fact: CrowdStrike's AIDR monitors prompts, data interactions and runtime behavior in AI products including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Copilot, and Cursor
key_facts.excerpt: AIDR for Desktop extends prompt-layer protections to desktop applications including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Microsoft Copilot, O365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor.

key_facts.fact: Palo Alto Networks launched Prisma AIRS 3.0 to secure the entire agentic AI lifecycle from observing interactions to safely authorizing autonomous execution
key_facts.excerpt: Prisma AIRS 3.0 secures the entire Agentic AI lifecycle – enabling enterprises to move from simply observing AI interactions to safely authorizing autonomous execution.

key_facts.fact: Cisco released DefenseClaw, an open-source secure agent framework that automates security and inventory, with plans to integrate with NVIDIA OpenShell as sandbox
key_facts.excerpt: Cisco introduces DefenseClaw, an open source secure agent framework that automates security and inventory, with plans to integrate with NVIDIA OpenShell as the sandbox.

key_facts.fact: Cisco extended Zero Trust access to AI agents via Duo IAM with MCP policy enforcement, enabling fine-grained permissions limiting agent tool access to specific resources and timeframes
key_facts.excerpt: Agents' tool access can be limited to specific time frames. A company could specify that agents may only perform certain actions during business hours.

stories.headline: Interloom Raises $16.5M to Capture 'Tacit Knowledge' for Enterprise AI Agents

key_facts.fact: Munich-based Interloom raised $16.5 million in a seed round led by DN Capital, with participation from Bek Ventures and Air Street Capital
key_facts.excerpt: The Munich, Berlin, and London-based AI startup has raised $16.5 million in a seed round led by DN Capital, with participation from Bek Ventures and Air Street Capital.

key_facts.fact: The company builds a 'context graph' by ingesting operational records like support emails, service tickets, and call transcripts to map how problems actually get resolved in organizations
key_facts.excerpt: Interloom ingests operational records—support emails, service tickets, call transcripts, work orders—to build a 'context graph,' mapping how problems actually get resolved within organizations.

key_facts.fact: Commerzbank deployed it to analyze millions of customer support emails, reducing the gap between documented and actual operational knowledge from ~50% to 5%
key_facts.excerpt: Commerzbank analyzed millions of customer support emails; reduced documented-vs-actual operational knowledge gap from ~50% to 5%.

key_facts.fact: Customers include Volkswagen and Zurich Insurance, which named Interloom winner of a company-wide AI competition beating ~2,000 competitors for underwriting use cases
key_facts.excerpt: Zurich Insurance won company-wide AI competition (beating ~2,000 competitors) for underwriting use cases.

key_facts.fact: Founded by Fabian Jakobi, serial entrepreneur who previously sold Boxplot to Hyperscience in 2021; the company is developing a 'Chief of Staff' product layer for managing AI agent performance
key_facts.excerpt: Developing a 'Chief of Staff' product layer providing managers real-time visibility into AI agent performance with version control for agent-driven processes.

stories.headline: Oracle Launches 22 Fusion Agentic Applications with Coordinated AI Agent Teams at AI World

key_facts.fact: Oracle announced Fusion Agentic Applications, a new class of 22 enterprise apps powered by coordinated teams of specialized AI agents that are outcome-driven and reasoning-based
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle today announced Fusion Agentic Applications, a new class of enterprise applications powered by coordinated teams of specialized AI agents that are outcome-driven, proactive and reasoning based.

key_facts.fact: Built into Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, the agents can make and execute decisions within business processes by accessing unified enterprise data, workflows, and approval hierarchies
key_facts.excerpt: Built into Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, Fusion Agentic Applications can make and execute decisions within business processes by securely accessing unified enterprise data, workflows, policies, approval hierarchies.

key_facts.fact: Applications span workforce operations, design-to-source workspace, cross-sell programs, and collectors workspace for cash collection
key_facts.excerpt: Specific examples include Workforce Operations, Design-to-Source Workspace, Cross-Sell Program Workspace, and Collectors Workspace.

key_facts.fact: Analyst Holger Mueller of Constellation Research said Oracle has moved ahead of ERP rivals including market-share leader SAP with this agentic approach
key_facts.excerpt: Holger Mueller, vice president and principal analyst at Constellation Research, said Oracle has moved ahead of its ERP rivals, including market-share leader SAP.

key_facts.fact: Announced at Oracle AI World in London on March 24, alongside updates to Oracle AI Agent Studio with a new Agentic Applications Builder
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle today announced the latest updates to Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications, a complete development platform for building, connecting, and running AI automation and agentic applications.
